description: 臺灣海岸極端暴潮線 [storm surge and coastal flooding] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 交通部中央氣象署. 透過歷史統計資料，計算極端暴潮水位，並與地形高度進行比較。 112年9月15日起異動下載網址，請於112年12月31日前改接，逾時舊版連結失效。 如需大量下載資料者請至氣象資料開放平臺申請會員 cwa. gov. tw/index. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 交通部中央氣象署. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml, json. The portal shows 2024-09-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
